item.text: The inherited Java runtime is absent in this container, so the launch currently fails before reaching GTK. I’ll inspect the restoration script and remaining preflight time before proceeding.

{"tool":"run","argument":"cat bounded_preflight.py; cat diagnostics/startup-reproduction.json; cat diagnostics/gtk-preflight-start.json 2>/dev/null; ls diagnostics; uname -m; python -c \"import time; print('CURRENT_EPOCH',time.time())\"","why":"Find the inherited runtime restoration commands and deadline record so Java 25 and Audiveris 5.11 can be restored before reproducing and repairing the missing GTK 3 library within the bounded preflight."}
